product_one_liner.value: Curve Dental provides an AI-powered, cloud-based platform for dental practices to manage clinical care, scheduling, insurance, billing, payments, and patient engagement.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes an AI-powered, cloud-based dental practice management platform connecting the listed clinical and administrative functions. Source: https://www.curvedental.com/.

pricing_page.notes: Curve has a public pricing page describing its offering and requesting a personalized quote. Source: https://www.curvedental.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The case study describes Curve being used across Dental Choice offices, and the pricing page includes an Emerson Dental customer testimonial. Sources: https://www.curvedental.com/case-studies/dr-hans-herchen and https://www.curvedental.com/pricing. | named_customers.0: The case study describes Curve supporting all 22 Dental Choice offices. Source: https://www.curvedental.com/case-studies/dr-hans-herchen. | named_customers.1: The pricing page attributes a testimonial about moving to Curve to Dr. Gregory Wu of Emerson Dental. Source: https://www.curvedental.com/pricing.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 215 employees, placing it in the requested 201-500 band. Employee counts are approximate. Source: https://www.linkedin.com/company/curve-dental-inc.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official contact page lists the corporate headquarters in Alpharetta. Source: https://www.curvedental.com/contact. | hq_country: The contact page labels the address Corporate Headquarters and places it in Alpharetta, Georgia, USA. USA is normalized to United States. Source: https://www.curvedental.com/contact.

founded_year.notes: The official about page explicitly states that Curve Dental was founded in 2004: https://www.curvedental.com/about.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed general and Product Development indexes contain practice-management advice, product promotion, and partnership announcements, rather than two engineer-authored explanations of how Curve is built. Sources: https://www.curvedental.com/blog and https://www.curvedental.com/blog/topic/product-development.

public_docs.notes: Curve has multiple public help articles covering Curve Go, charting, and Get My Data, with additional documentation linked from the charting article. Sources: https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50146794650771-Curve-Go-Overview, https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50524013478035-How-Do-You-Chart-Treatment-in-Curve, and https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50285138160915-Using-Get-My-Data.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official posting is titled AI/ML Platform Software Developer and displays an Apply now action. Source: https://ats.rippling.com/curve-dental/jobs/81f0c253-0884-422b-8e3a-6c3ed40aac42.

model_provider.notes: Curve explicitly describes its integration with Pearl’s Second Opinion and opening Pearl’s software for AI-assisted radiograph review. This identifies the integration provider, not an underlying foundation model. Source: https://www.curvedental.com/the-benefits-of-pearl-ais-integration-with-curve.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The data policy names all three. Scope matters: Curve says it follows HIPAA privacy regulations, while SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are explicitly claims about its data center, not a statement that Curve itself holds those certifications. Source: https://www.curvedental.com/data-policy. | compliance_certs.0: The data policy explicitly claims SOC 2 compliance for the data center. Source: https://www.curvedental.com/data-policy. | compliance_certs.1: The data policy names an ISO 27001-certified information security management system for its data center. Source: https://www.curvedental.com/data-policy. | compliance_certs.2: Curve explicitly says it follows privacy regulations including HIPAA; this is a compliance statement, not a separate HIPAA certification. Source: https://www.curvedental.com/data-policy.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile labels the sole reported round Series A. Other transaction descriptions use growth-capital or buyout terminology, so the stage classification is not uniform. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/curvedental/__Nj2kM80gIT3sQBO1s_TYQzarI7WWkLHuu8rMoCGAnrQ/funding-and-investors. | funding_date: The funding profile reports a single round on February 8, 2018, corroborated by the dated investment announcement; this normalizes to 2018-02. Sources: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/curvedental/__Nj2kM80gIT3sQBO1s_TYQzarI7WWkLHuu8rMoCGAnrQ/funding-and-investors and https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2018/02/08/1336376/0/en/battery-ventures-and-curve-dental-announce-agreement-for-significant-equity-investment.html. | funding_amount_usd: The reported funding amount is explicitly undisclosed, so the USD amount remains null rather than zero. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/curvedental/__Nj2kM80gIT3sQBO1s_TYQzarI7WWkLHuu8rMoCGAnrQ/funding-and-investors.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported funding round is February 8, 2018, well outside the preceding 18 months; no later round was found. Sources: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/curvedental/__Nj2kM80gIT3sQBO1s_TYQzarI7WWkLHuu8rMoCGAnrQ/funding-and-investors and https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2018/02/08/1336376/0/en/battery-ventures-and-curve-dental-announce-agreement-for-significant-equity-investment.html.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official Customer Account Executive posting displays an Apply now action, satisfying the account-executive title requirement. Source: https://ats.rippling.com/curve-dental/jobs/7c7f84e9-7dac-495b-b18f-05b3bd17149f.

launched_6mo.notes: Curve announced Curve Memberships on September 3, 2026, within the preceding six months. Source: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/curve-dental-introduces-curve-memberships-helping-practices-strengthen-patient-retention--profitability-through-membership-driven-care-302869029.html.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The September 29, 2026 announcement appoints Rick Hansen Chief Customer Officer, within the preceding 12 months. Source: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/curve-dental-names-rick-hansen-chief-customer-officer-to-build-a-new-standard-for-customer-experience-in-dental-software-302892423.html.
